extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and research organisations in the UK seeking EPSRC/UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Identify and check eligibility, scope, funding levels, deadlines, and funder information for EPSRC funding opportunities listed on the EPSRC site. Useful for researchers or administrators preparing an application or assessing fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant institutional eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for EPSRC funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated explicitly on the 'Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills' opportunity; applicants should confirm their host organisation is recognised as eligible by EPSRC before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied to the 'UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment' opportunity — only invited applicants may submit full applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type and award range
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding type: Grant. Award range: £10,000,000 - £11,300,000 (for the Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills opportunity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opportunity listings include the funding type and the award range; applicants should plan proposals and budgets consistent with the stated funding range and type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fund and full economic cost (FEC) funding percentage
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the metascience scientometrics opportunity, the award is expected to cover 80% of the project's FEC; applicants must prepare costings and indicate the proportion funded accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project scope and objectives — Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to establish a UK centre for quantum commercialisation skills that will provide opportunities for researchers to develop commercialisation skills, engage with industry, and explore new career pathways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should align with the stated aim to build commercialisation skills, industry engagement and career pathways; scope and activities should reflect these goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project scope and objectives — Metascience scientometrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to develop, validate, and critique novel scientometric indicators for use in research assessment and in metascience research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should focus on the development, validation, or critique of scientometric indicators intended for use in research assessment or metascience; note this opportunity is invite-only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity status and precise timelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunity status (e.g., Open) and exact publication/opening/closing dates and times are provided (dates and times given in UK time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must submit within the listed opening and closing windows (e.g., Opening date: 6 May 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date: 7 July 2026 4:00pm UK time). Check time zone and deadline time precisely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funders and co-funders disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The opportunity listing includes the funders and any co-funders (e.g., UK Research and Innovation, ESRC, NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC; co-funder: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi-agency funding is explicitly noted; applicants should be aware of co-funder involvement and any related expectations or eligibility nuances.
